channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Man admits threatening TVM journalist handed probation and anger-management order
item.description: Man who sent abusive and menacing audio messages to TVM head of news Owen Galea after a news item involving one of his relatives was aired

item.title: Court upholds appeal after earlier prostitution sentence failed to balance punishment and reform
item.description: Woman’s loitering conviction overturned on appeal after original sentence failed to balance retributive and reformative aspects of criminal justice

item.title: Local artist Lisa Cassar launches debut solo exhibition
item.description: Local artist Lisa Cassar has launched her debut solo exhibition, where I go to breathe, at Camilleri Paris Mode in Rabat

item.title: Court throws out AG appeal in €200,000 diamond dispute, confirms woman never committed crime
item.description: Long-running dispute between former partners over €200,000 diamond collection has ended with the Court of Criminal Appeal confirms no criminal offence had ever been committed by the woman accused

item.title: PN slams €311,000 spending on Ta Qali picnic area gravel
item.description: After Momentum’s Freedom of Information request on the gravelling of Ta’ Qali, Nationalist Party says area should be restored to its original state

item.title: Man jailed for 13 years after plea deal on major cocaine trafficking case
item.description: Dean Martin sentenced to 13 years in prison and a €25,000 fine after upholding a plea bargain reached between his defence team and the Attorney General, sparing him the possibility of a life sentence

item.title: Have you seen this man? Public asked to help find 56-year-old missing man
item.description: The public has been asked to help locate Graham Laws

item.title: Malta part of Europe-wide sting on crypto fraudsters
item.description: Maltese Police played a key role in an international operation which dismantled a major cryptocurrency fraud and money laundering network responsible for stealing over €700 million from thousands of victims across Europe

item.title: Clyde Caruana joins opposition against proposed Żabbar elderly home
item.description: Finance Minister Clyde Caruana supports local council’s position against development of a five-storey elderly home in his home town of Żabbar

item.title: Eurovision 2026: Israel allowed to compete as Ireland, Spain, Netherlands and Slovenia boycott
item.description: Ireland, Spain, the Netherlands and Slovenia will be boycotting the 2026 Eurovision Song Contest, after Israel was allowed to compete
